review:
Oskar and Fred, two brothers who smash the grid. Cash symbols expand upward into Cash Stacks worth up to 10,000x the bet, and all stacks on screen add together.

Once the grid settles, Oskar might knock out a reel and drop in a new Cash Stack, or Fred might squash the stacks together and double them. Chaotic and fun. The Bros Before Blows bonus makes stacks more frequent. 10,000x max.
